$comment: Reviewed exceptions for yarn check:external-deps. Each entry allows one host in specific paths only. Stale entries fail the check. Policy and process: docs/EXTERNAL_RUNTIME_DEPS.md

exceptions.reason: Default MapLibre style for the Map kit. Vector tile services cannot reasonably be bundled.
exceptions.impact: Apps using the default map theme must allow basemaps.cartocdn.com (and the tile hosts its style references) in CSP connect-src/img-src. If CARTO is down, maps render without tiles; the rest of the page is unaffected.
